PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Strategic and results-driven Senior Product Owner with 12+ years of experience in FinTech, BFSI, 
NBFC, and Commercial Payments, delivering enterprise-scale payment products for US banking 
clients. Deep expertise across Commercial Cards, ACH, Wire Transfers, Settlement workflows, 
B2B Payment Products, API-led integrations, and payment modernization initiatives including 
ISO 20022 (PAIN flow) . Proven track record of managing cross -functional Agile teams of 10+ 
members, translating complex business requirements into scalable digital products, and driving 
operational efficiency, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes. 
Recognized for combining product thinking, business analysis expertise, and execution leadership 
to deliver high -impact payment capabilities such as Virtual Card Prefunding solutions that 
improved client funding visibility and payment transparency for B2B commercial customers.
